study type: retrospective before and after comparative study
exposure: action research project promoting physiological labor and birth
outcome: frequency of oxytocin augmentation in spontaneous labor
cohort: 903 primiparous and multiparous women with spontaneous onset of labor
finding: Following an action research project, duration of admission CTG, frequency of admission CTG duration over 30min, the use of scalp electrodes, and use of oxytocin augmentation of spontaneous labor were reduced significantly.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in mode of birth.
